title: Frens: mobile app to keep your connections
tagline: Exchange humanity proved business cards and claim the Frens Token for proving your connection between your friends only when you meet them up in person.
description: With Frens we can provide a humanity proved business cards and give people the proof of connection tokens. It's Non Fungible and claims can only be made by meeting physically in-person. It will prove your actual connection and can show your reputation among your friends and professional connections. The business card is customizable with NFTs and can import your ENS, it can be use as a social status too.
how_its_made: We built our server on NextJS where 2 people send requests to match and earn mint Frens tokens. Created an ERC721 Frens tokens, both people that connect receive the Token each other which proves the connection between 2 people. We built an iOS app with SwiftUI to make sure the users were in the same place and swipe up the button to connect. We can connect with our existing wallet from iOS app using @WalletConnect. After we connect our wallet, we can import our ENS name from @ensdomains. We made it multi chain, user can choose the chain from @0xPolygon and @optimismPBC or Ethereum. As an endpoint provider, we used @POKTnetwork. We used @worldcoin to proof that the person is actually a human. We can import NFTs and choose a profile image from them using the API from @opensea or we can upload an image and store it to @IPFS using the API from @tatum_io.
